title: Creamy Corn and Pastry Tartlets
description: A delicious dessert featuring a flaky pastry crust filled with a creamy corn and mellow cheese mixture. Perfect for a fancy dinner party.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll out the choux pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Cut out circles of pastry using a cookie cutter.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mellow cheese, French cream cheese, and corn kernels.
Place a spoonful of the cheese mixture onto one half of each pastry circle. Brush the edges with beaten eggs.
Fold the pastry in half to enclose the filling. Press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry with the remaining egg. Sprinkle with salt.
Place the tartlets on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow the tartlets to cool on a wire rack before serving.
